questions.stem: In a queue of 35 candidates, a candidate is 19th from the front. After moving 4 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 13. New front rank = 19+4 = 23. Back rank = 35 − 23 + 1 = 13.

questions.stem: In a queue of 48 candidates, a candidate is 20th from the front. After moving 3 places towards the back, what is the candidate’s rank from the back?
questions.explanation: Answer: 26. New front rank = 20+3 = 23. Back rank = 48 − 23 + 1 = 26.

questions.stem:
Statements: Only a few coins are loans. Some loans are files. All files are notes.
Conclusions:
I. All coins are notes.
II. No loans is a notes.
questions.explanation: Answer: Neither I nor II follows. A need not be contained in D. Some B are C and therefore D, contradicting II.

questions.stem:
Statements: Some coins are loans. All loans are files. No files is a notes.
Conclusions:
I. Some coins are files.
II. Some loans are notes.
questions.explanation: Answer: Only I follows. The stated A–B overlap lies in C. Since B is contained in C, no B can be D.

questions.stem:
Statements: No coins is a loans. Some loans are files. All files are notes.
Conclusions:
I. All coins are notes.
II. Some notes are loans.
questions.explanation: Answer: Only II follows. The B–C overlap is inside D, proving II. No universal A–D relation is given.

questions.stem:
Statements: Only a few coins are loans. All loans are files. No files is a notes.
Conclusions:
I. Some coins are not loans.
II. No loans is a notes.
questions.explanation: Answer: Both I and II follow. Only a few means some are and some are not. All B are C and no C is D excludes every B from D.

questions.stem: G is the mother of D. B is the son of D. A is the father of D. How is B related to A?
questions.explanation: Answer: Grandson. A is a parent of D, and B is D’s son. Hence B is A’s grandchild.

questions.stem: G is the only daughter of A. A is the father of G. H is the son of G. F is the sister of A. How is A related to H?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal grandfather. A is the father of G, and G is H’s mother. Thus A is the maternal grandfather.

questions.stem: C is the brother of G. G is the mother of B. H is the father of C and G. How is C related to B?
questions.explanation: Answer: Maternal uncle. C is the brother of B’s mother G. Therefore C is the maternal uncle.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 64 km north, turns left and walks 132 km, then turns left and walks 9 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Answer: 143. The first and third legs oppose each other. Net components are 55 km along the initial direction and 132 km perpendicular to it. Distance = √(55² + 132²) = 143 km.

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 24 km north, turns right and walks 28 km, then turns right and walks 3 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?

questions.stem: A surveyor walks 87 km west, turns left and walks 180 km, then turns left and walks 12 km. What is the shortest distance (km) from the starting point?

questions.stem: A father is three times as old as his daughter. After 5 years, their combined age will be 78 years. Find the father’s present age.
questions.explanation: Answer: 51. Let daughter’s age be x. Father is 3x. 4x + 10 = 78; x = 17, so father = 51.

questions.stem: What is the difference (₹) between compound interest and simple interest on ₹16000 at 5% per annum for 2 years, compounded annually?
questions.explanation: Answer: 40. For 2 years, CI − SI = P(r/100)² = 16000 × (5/100)².

questions.stem: A can finish a job in 24 days and B in 36 days. They work together for 2 days, then B leaves. How many more days does A need? (Round to two decimal places if needed.)
questions.explanation: Answer: 20.67. Use 72 work units. Rates: A = 3, B = 2 units/day. Remaining = 72 − 2×5. Divide by A’s rate 3.

questions.stem: A invests ₹23000 for 12 months. B invests ₹46000 for 6 months. Total profit is ₹62400. Find B’s share (₹).
questions.explanation: Answer: 31200. Capital-time ratio = 12 : 12. B’s share = total × 12/(24) = 31200.
